proposed.text: Under PD 1096 RIRR, what is a prefabricated assembly?

options.text: A structural unit whose integral parts are built up or assembled before incorporation into the building
A decorative finish applied only after occupancy
A zoning certificate for subdivision land
A purely manual sketch with no structural unit

proposed.rationale: Rule XV Section 1501 defines prefabricated assemblies as structural units built or assembled before incorporation.
